marrow__ANAT_CH41_Q015.takeaway: Sibson fascia spans the thoracic inlet and attaches posteriorly to the anterior border of the C7 transverse process.
marrow__ANAT_CH41_Q015.displayText: The stabbed lung apex is covered by Sibson's fascia (suprapleural membrane). The source states that its vertebral attachment is posteriorly to the anterior border of the transverse process of the C7 vertebra; anteriorly it attaches to the inner border of the first rib.
